rules.title: App cache
rules.whatItIs: A cache an app keeps so it can start faster.
rules.consequence: The app will be slower the next time it opens while it rebuilds the cache, and an app that stores real data here could lose it.
rules.sideCondition: Close the app first. Do not offer this when the owning app is unknown.

rules.title: Apple system cache
rules.whatItIs: A cache belonging to macOS or an Apple app.
rules.consequence: It is probably harmless to remove but belongs to running system services, and the benefit is small.
rules.sideCondition: Not offered. macOS clears these itself.

rules.title: Homebrew downloads
rules.whatItIs: Bottles, app installers and package lists Homebrew downloaded, kept after installing.
rules.consequence: Homebrew downloads a package again only if you reinstall or upgrade it.
rules.sideCondition: Use the command rather than deleting by hand; plain `brew cleanup` keeps recent downloads and freed nothing in our test.

evidence.observed: Reached 618 MB after installing 15 formulae (73 with dependencies) and 3 casks. `brew cleanup --prune=all` freed 579 MB, leaving 40 MB of package lists; with the cache refilled to 1.3 GB, plain `brew cleanup` would have freed nothing. After deleting the folder, `brew reinstall jq` worked and the folder came back at 40 MB.

rules.title: JetBrains IDE data
rules.whatItIs: Indexes, caches and logs for a JetBrains IDE, including its Local History.
rules.consequence: Indexes rebuild slowly, and Local History (your edit history outside version control) cannot be recovered.
rules.sideCondition: Close the IDE first. Never offer this as one blob.

rules.title: Spotify offline songs
rules.whatItIs: Songs Spotify saved for offline listening.
rules.consequence: You will need to download the songs again, with network access and your account.

rules.title: Xcode cache
rules.whatItIs: Cached data that Xcode uses for indexing.
rules.consequence: Xcode will re-index and fetch some information again.

rules.title: Chrome cache
rules.whatItIs: Web pages and images Chrome saved to load sites faster.
rules.consequence: Pages load more slowly the first time you visit them again; your logins are not stored here.

rules.title: Firefox cache
rules.whatItIs: Web pages and images Firefox saved to load sites faster.
rules.consequence: Pages load more slowly the first time you visit them again; your logins are not stored here.

rules.title: Cache folder that may hold your data
rules.whatItIs: A folder inside a cache whose name suggests saved content rather than temporary files.
rules.consequence: If it holds your own content, removing it could lose that content for good.
rules.sideCondition: Based on the folder name only, so treat it as a hint.

rules.title: Database inside a cache
rules.whatItIs: A database file inside a cache folder that does not look like a cache.
rules.consequence: If it holds your own records, removing it could lose them for good.
rules.sideCondition: Based on the file name only, so treat it as a hint.
